register.description: The ISC Region 0 Control Register defines the control fields for the initiator Iquasar_i.mst region 0 ISC.

bitfield.description: Clear output priv attribute. If each bit is set then the outgoing priv bit is cleared. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Set outgoing priv attribute. If each bit is set then the outgoing priv bit is set. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
No privID replacement, pass through value. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Make outgoing non-secure. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Make outgoing secure. A value of 0xA enables, others disable. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Priv ID. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Default region indication. The default region is used when all other regions do not match. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Enable channel mode to match region to a chanid value. Otherwise use address mode to match region to an address range. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Lock region. Once set the region values cannot be modified. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Enable region. A value of 0xA enables, others disable. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: The ISC Region 0 Start Address Low Register defines the start address bits 31 to 0 for the initiator Iquasar_i.mst region 0 ISC.

bitfield.description: Start address bits 31 to 12. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Start address bits 11 to 0 must be 0 as address must be 4KB aligned in address mode. Can also be channel number in channel mode. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: The ISC Region 0 Start Address High Register defines the start address bits 47 to 32 for the initiator Iquasar_i.mst region 0 ISC.

bitfield.description: Start address bits 47 to 32. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: The ISC Region 0 End Address Low Register defines the end included address bits 31 to 0 for the initiator Iquasar_i.mst region 0 ISC.

bitfield.description: End address bits 31 to 12 to include in the match. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
End address bits 11 to 0 are forced to Fs as address must be 4KB aligned. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: The ISC Region 0 End Address High Register defines the end address bits 47 to 32 for the initiator Iquasar_i.mst region 0 ISC.

bitfield.description: End address bits 47 to 32. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n

register.description: The ISC Default Region Control Register defines the control fields for the initiator Iquasar_i.mst region 1 ISC.

bitfield.description: Clear output priv attribute. If each bit is set then the outgoing priv bit is cleared, else the bit is unchanged. Do not set both priv and nopriv for the same bit. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n

Set outgoing priv attribute. If each bit is set then the outgoing priv bit is set, else the bit is unchanged. Do not set both priv and nopriv for the same bit. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
No privID replacement. A value of 1 will pass through privid value. A value of 0 will replace privid with priv_id field value. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Make outgoing non-secure. A value of 1 forces secure clear, others do nothing. Do not set both sec and nonsec. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Make outgoing secure. A value of 0xA forces secure set, others do nothing. Do not set both sec and nonsec. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Priv ID value to use if pass is 0. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Default region indication. The default region is used when all other regions do not match. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Enable channel mode to match region to a chanid value. Otherwise use address mode to match region to an address range. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Lock region. Once set, the region values cannot be modified. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
Enable region. A value of 0xA enables, others disable. Reset Source: sms_custom_rst_mod_g_rst_n
